Package com.github.query4j.optimizer.join

Class JoinReorderOptimizerImpl

java.lang.Object
com.github.query4j.optimizer.join.JoinReorderOptimizerImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
JoinReorderOptimizer
public class JoinReorderOptimizerImpl extends Object implements JoinReorderOptimizer
Implementation of JoinReorderOptimizer that analyzes join sequences and suggests optimal reordering to minimize intermediate result sizes.

1.0.0
